Bootstrap a Debian root filesystem with mmdebstrap.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name         | Default    | Description                                                                             |
| ------------ | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `suite`      | `"stable"` | Debian suite or codename, such as bookworm or trixie.                                   |
| `snapshot`   | `""`       | Debian snapshot timestamp. Empty uses the selected mirror instead.                      |
| `mirror`     | `""`       | Custom Debian mirror URL. Empty uses mmdebstrap's default. A snapshot takes precedence. |
| `components` | `"main"`   | Space-separated archive components for an explicit custom mirror.                       |

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value      |
| ------------ | ---------- |
| Priority     | `10000000` |
| Dependencies | None       |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Use this recipe in a root layer. A snapshot selects a dated Debian archive and
disables its validity-date check. A custom mirror is passed to mmdebstrap as a
trusted source. The components parameter applies to that custom mirror.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a root layer (set `root = true` instead of a
parent):

```toml title="layers/base.toml"
root = true
recipes = ["core/debian-bootstrap"]

[parameters."core/debian-bootstrap"]
suite = "trixie"
```
